requirements.quote: The "H" point for each seat shall be determined in accordance with the procedure described in Annex 6
requirements.text: The front-seat restraint system shall be dimensioned around an H point for each front seat determined in accordance with the Annex 6 procedure.

requirements.quote: When the protective system for the front seating positions includes belts, the belt components shall meet the requirements of Regulation No. 16
requirements.text: Where the front-seat protective system includes belts, the belt webbing, retractors, pretensioners and load limiters shall meet the requirements of UN Regulation No. 16.

requirements.quote: Seating positions where a dummy is installed and the protective system includes belts, shall be provided with anchorage points conforming to Regulation No. 14
requirements.text: The front seat frames with belt anchorages shall provide anchorage points conforming to UN Regulation No. 14 at every front seating position equipped with a belt.

requirements.quote: The head performance criterion (HPC) shall not exceed 1,000 and the resultant head acceleration shall not exceed 80 g for more than 3 ms
requirements.text: The front structure, airbag modules and steering column shall limit the head performance criterion of the front outboard dummies to not more than 1,000 and the resultant head acceleration to not more than 80 g for more than 3 ms, calculated cumulatively excluding rebound.

requirements.quote: The Injury Criteria for the neck (NIC) shall not exceed the values shown in Figures 1 and 2
requirements.text: The front airbag modules and belt load limiters shall limit the neck injury criteria of the front outboard dummies to the values shown in Figures 1 and 2 of UN R94.

requirements.quote: The neck bending moment about the y axis shall no exceed 57 Nm in extension
requirements.text: The front airbag modules shall limit the neck bending moment about the y axis of the front outboard dummies to not more than 57 Nm in extension.

requirements.quote: The Thorax Compression Criterion (ThCC) shall not exceed 42 mm
requirements.text: The front seat belt load limiters and airbag modules shall limit the thorax compression criterion of the front outboard dummies to not more than 42 mm.

requirements.quote: The viscous criterion (V * C) for the thorax shall not exceed 1,0 m/s
requirements.text: The restraint system shall limit the viscous criterion for the thorax of the front outboard dummies to not more than 1.0 m/s.

requirements.quote: The femur force criterion (FFC) shall not exceed the force-time performance criterion shown in Figure 3
requirements.text: The front structure and restraint system shall limit the femur force criterion of the front outboard dummies to the force-time performance shown in Figure 3 of UN R94.

requirements.quote: The tibia compression force criterion (TCFC) shall not exceed 8 kN
requirements.text: The front structure shall limit the tibia compression force criterion of the front outboard dummies to not more than 8 kN.

requirements.quote: The tibia index (TI), measured at the top and bottom of each tibia, shall not exceed 1,3 at either location
requirements.text: The front structure and footwell shall limit the tibia index of the front outboard dummies to not more than 1.3 at both the top and bottom of each tibia.

requirements.quote: The movement of the sliding knee joints shall not exceed 15 mm
requirements.text: The front structure shall limit the movement of the sliding knee joints of the front outboard dummies to not more than 15 mm.

requirements.quote: the residual steering wheel displacement, when measured at the centre of the steering wheel hub, shall not exceed 80 mm in the upwards vertical direction and 100 mm in the rearward horizontal direction
requirements.text: The steering column with its energy-absorbing deformation element shall limit the residual steering wheel displacement, measured at the hub centre, to not more than 80 mm upwards and 100 mm rearwards after the impact.

requirements.quote: During the test no door shall open
requirements.text: The body-in-white and door retention shall keep every door closed during the frontal impact test.

requirements.quote: After the impact, the side doors shall be unlocked
requirements.text: The door locking system shall leave the side doors unlocked after the impact.

requirements.quote: In the case of vehicles equipped with an automatically activated door locking system, the doors shall be locked before the moment of impact and be unlocked after the impact
requirements.text: Where an automatically activated door locking system is fitted, the doors shall be locked before the moment of impact and unlocked after the impact.

requirements.quote: To open at least one door per row of seats
requirements.text: The structure and restraint system shall allow at least one door per row of seats to be opened after the impact without the use of tools.

requirements.quote: To release the dummies from their restraint system which, if locked, shall be capable of being released by a maximum force of 60 N on the centre of the release control
requirements.text: The seat belt buckle release control shall release the locked restraint system with a maximum force of 60 N applied at its centre after the impact.

requirements.quote: To remove the dummies from the vehicle without adjustment of the seats
requirements.text: The front seat frames and restraint system shall allow the occupants to be removed from the vehicle without adjustment of the seats after the impact.

requirements.quote: If there is continuous leakage of liquid from the fuel-feed installation after the collision, the rate of leakage shall not exceed 30 g/min
requirements.text: Where continuous leakage of liquid from the fuel-feed installation occurs after the collision, the leakage rate shall not exceed 30 g/min.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark
requirements.text: The vehicle shall carry an international approval mark affixed conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: A circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval
requirements.text: The approval mark shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which granted approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number, to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 4.4.1. above
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the E circle.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate.

requirements.quote: a = 8 mm min.
requirements.text: The characters of the approval mark shall have a height of at least 8 mm.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall overlap the barrier face by 40 per cent ± 20 mm
requirements.text: The front-end structure shall be designed to be evaluated with the vehicle overlapping the deformable barrier face by 40 per cent ± 20 mm, first contact on the steering-column side.

requirements.quote: Vehicle speed at the moment of impact shall be 56 -0/+1 km/h
requirements.text: The front structure and restraint system shall withstand a frontal impact at a vehicle speed of 56 -0/+1 km/h at the moment of impact.

requirements.quote: The acceleration (a) referring to the centre of gravity is calculated from the triaxial components of the acceleration measured with a CFC of 1,000
requirements.text: The head acceleration channel used to judge the restraint system shall be recorded with a CFC of 1,000.

requirements.quote: The bending moment about a lateral axis at the neck/head interface are measured with a CFC of 600
requirements.text: The neck bending moment channel used to judge the restraint system shall be recorded with a CFC of 600.

requirements.quote: The chest deflection between the sternum and the spine is measured with a CFC of 180
requirements.text: The chest deflection channel used to judge the thorax criterion shall be recorded with a CFC of 180.

requirements.quote: The axial compressive force and the bending moments are measured with a CFC of 600
requirements.text: The femur and tibia force and bending moment channels used to judge the restraint system shall be recorded with a CFC of 600.

requirements.quote: the deceleration time history of the structure shall be determined on the basis of the value of the longitudinal accelerometers at the base of the "B" pillar on the struck side of the vehicle with a CFC of 180
requirements.text: The front-end structure shall provide a deceleration time history measurable at the base of the struck-side B pillar with a CFC of 180.

requirements.quote: The temperature of the dummy and the system of measuring instruments shall be stabilized before the test and maintained so far as possible within a range between 19 °C and 22.2 °C
requirements.text: The restraint system test shall be conducted with dummy and instrumentation temperature stabilised within 19 °C to 22.2 °C.

requirements.quote: Apply a 9 to 18 N tension load to the lap belt
requirements.text: For the restraint system adjustment, a tension load of 9 to 18 N shall be applied to the lap belt.

requirements.quote: The absolute value of the linearity error of a data channel at any frequency in the CFC, shall be equal to or less than 2.5 per cent of the value of the CAC, over the whole measurement range
requirements.text: The linearity error of each data channel used for the restraint system measurements shall not exceed 2.5 per cent of the CAC over the whole measurement range.

requirements.quote: The relative time delay between the signal of two or more data channels, regardless of their frequency class, must not exceed 1 ms excluding delay caused by phase shift
requirements.text: The relative time delay between any two data channels shall not exceed 1 ms excluding phase-shift delay.

requirements.quote: The transducer cross sensitivity shall be less than 5 per cent in any direction
requirements.text: The cross sensitivity of every transducer in the crash measurement chain shall be less than 5 per cent in any direction.

requirements.quote: The sampling frequency should be equal to at least 8 FH
requirements.text: The data acquisition shall sample each channel at a frequency of at least 8 FH.

requirements.quote: When the protective system for the front seating positions includes belts, the belt components shall meet the requirements of Regulation No. 16
requirements.text: Where the front-seat protective system includes belts, the belt webbing, retractors, pretensioners and load limiters shall meet the requirements of UN Regulation No. 16.

requirements.quote: Seating positions where a dummy is installed and the protective system includes belts, shall be provided with anchorage points conforming to Regulation No. 14
requirements.text: The front seat frames with belt anchorages shall provide anchorage points conforming to UN Regulation No. 14 at the front seating positions.

requirements.quote: The head performance criterion (HPC) shall not exceed 1000 and the resultant head acceleration shall not exceed 80 g for more than 3 ms
requirements.text: The restraint system shall limit the HPC of the 50th percentile driver dummy to not more than 1000 and the resultant head acceleration to not more than 80 g for more than 3 ms.

requirements.quote: The axial tensile neck force shall not exceed 3.3 kN
requirements.text: The restraint system shall limit the axial tensile neck force of the 50th percentile driver dummy to not more than 3.3 kN.

requirements.quote: The fore/aft shear forces at the head/neck interface shall not exceed 3.1 kN
requirements.text: The restraint system shall limit the fore/aft shear forces at the head/neck interface of the 50th percentile driver dummy to not more than 3.1 kN.

requirements.quote: The thorax compression criterion (ThCC) shall not exceed 42 mm
requirements.text: The front seat belt load limiters and airbags shall limit the thorax compression criterion of the 50th percentile driver dummy to not more than 42 mm.

requirements.quote: The viscous criterion (V * C) for the thorax shall not exceed 1.0 m/s
requirements.text: The restraint system shall limit the viscous criterion for the thorax of the 50th percentile driver dummy to not more than 1.0 m/s.

requirements.quote: The femur force criterion (FFC) shall not exceed 9.07 kN
requirements.text: The front structure and restraint system shall limit the femur force criterion of the 50th percentile driver dummy to not more than 9.07 kN.

requirements.quote: The axial tensile neck force shall not exceed 2.9 kN
requirements.text: The restraint system shall limit the axial tensile neck force of the 5th percentile passenger dummy to not more than 2.9 kN.

requirements.quote: The fore/aft shear forces at the head/neck interface shall not exceed 2.7 kN
requirements.text: The restraint system shall limit the fore/aft shear forces at the head/neck interface of the 5th percentile passenger dummy to not more than 2.7 kN.

requirements.quote: 34 mm in the case of vehicles of category M1
requirements.text: The passenger airbag module and belt load limiter shall limit the thorax compression criterion of the 5th percentile female passenger dummy to not more than 34 mm in the M1 vehicle.

requirements.quote: The viscous criterion (V * C) for the thorax shall not exceed 1.0 m/s
requirements.text: The restraint system shall limit the viscous criterion for the thorax of the 5th percentile passenger dummy to not more than 1.0 m/s.

requirements.quote: The femur force criterion (FFC) shall not exceed 7 kN
requirements.text: The front structure and restraint system shall limit the femur force criterion of the 5th percentile passenger dummy to not more than 7 kN.

requirements.quote: the residual steering wheel displacement, when measured at the centre of the steering wheel hub, shall not exceed 80 mm in the upwards vertical direction and 100 mm in the rearward horizontal direction
requirements.text: The steering column with its energy-absorbing deformation element shall limit the residual steering wheel displacement at the hub centre to not more than 80 mm upwards and 100 mm rearwards after the test.

requirements.quote: During the test no door shall open
requirements.text: The body-in-white and door retention shall keep every door closed during the full-width rigid barrier test.

requirements.quote: After the impact, the side doors shall be unlocked
requirements.text: The door locking system shall leave the side doors unlocked after the impact.

requirements.quote: To open at least one door per row of seats
requirements.text: The structure shall allow at least one door per row of seats to be opened after the impact without the use of tools.

requirements.quote: To release the dummies from their restraint system which, locked, shall be capable of being released by a maximum force of 60 N on the centre of the release control
requirements.text: The seat belt buckle release control shall release the locked restraint system with a maximum force of 60 N applied at its centre after the impact.

requirements.quote: To remove the dummies from the vehicle without adjustment of the seats
requirements.text: The front seat frames and restraint system shall allow the dummies to be removed from the vehicle without adjustment of the seats.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark
requirements.text: The vehicle shall carry an international approval mark affixed conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: A circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval
requirements.text: The approval mark shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number, to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 4.4.1. above
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the E circle.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate.

requirements.quote: a = 8 mm min.
requirements.text: The characters of the approval mark shall have a height of at least 8 mm.

requirements.quote: the maximum lateral misalignment tolerated between the vertical median line of the front of the vehicle and the vertical median line of the collision wall is ± 30 cm
requirements.text: The front-end structure shall withstand a full-width rigid barrier test with a lateral misalignment between the vehicle front centreline and the wall centreline of not more than ± 30 cm.

requirements.quote: Vehicle speed at the moment of impact shall be 50 -0/ +1 km/h
requirements.text: The front structure and restraint system shall withstand a full-width rigid barrier impact at a vehicle speed of 50 -0/+1 km/h.

requirements.quote: The acceleration (a) referring to the centre of gravity is calculated from the triaxial components of the acceleration measured with a CFC of 1000
requirements.text: The head acceleration channel used to judge the restraint system shall be recorded with a CFC of 1000.

requirements.quote: The bending moment about a lateral axis at the neck/head interface are measured with a CFC of 600
requirements.text: The neck bending moment channel used to judge the restraint system shall be recorded with a CFC of 600.

requirements.quote: The chest deflection between the sternum and the spine is measured with a CFC of 180
requirements.text: The chest deflection channel used to judge the thorax criterion shall be recorded with a CFC of 180.

requirements.quote: The axial compressive force is measured with a CFC of 600
requirements.text: The femur axial compressive force channel used to judge the restraint system shall be recorded with a CFC of 600.

requirements.quote: The maximum value of ∂t shall be 1.25 x 10⁻⁴ seconds
requirements.text: The sternum deflection data used to calculate the viscous criterion shall be sampled with a maximum time interval of 1.25 x 10-4 seconds.

requirements.quote: The temperature of the dummy and the system of measuring instruments shall be stabilized before the test and maintained so far as possible within a range between 19 °C and 22.2 °C
requirements.text: The restraint system test shall be conducted with dummy and instrumentation temperature stabilised within 19 °C to 22.2 °C.

requirements.quote: the angle measured from the horizontal on the 76.2 mm (3 inch) flat surface of the gauge shall be 20 degrees plus or minus 2.5 degrees
requirements.text: The passenger seat cushion shall allow the 5th percentile female dummy to be set at a pelvic angle of 20 degrees ± 2.5 degrees.

requirements.quote: Apply a 9 to 18 N tension load to the lap belt
requirements.text: For the restraint system adjustment, a tension load of 9 to 18 N shall be applied to the lap belt.

requirements.quote: The frequency response of a data channel shall lie within the limiting curves given in Figure 1 of this annex
requirements.text: The frequency response of each data channel used for the restraint system measurements shall lie within the limiting curves of Figure 1 of Annex 8.

requirements.quote: Any mounting having a lowest resonance frequency equal to at least 5 times the frequency FH of the data channel considered shall be considered valid
requirements.text: The mounting of each transducer shall have a lowest resonance frequency of at least 5 times the FH of its data channel.

requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury
requirements.text: The external surface of the front-end structure, including the bumper beam and its cover, shall not exhibit outward-directed pointed or sharp parts or projections likely to increase the risk or seriousness of pedestrian injury.

requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists
requirements.text: The front bumper and body panels shall not exhibit any outward-directed part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm
requirements.text: Every protruding part of the external front surface shall have a radius of curvature of at least 2.5 mm.

requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm
requirements.text: Parts of the external front surface protruding less than 5 mm shall have their outward facing angles blunted, except where they protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.quote: Protruding parts of the external surface, made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm
requirements.text: Protruding parts of the external front surface made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A may have a radius of curvature below 2.5 mm.

requirements.quote: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point
requirements.text: An ornament on the front external surface projecting more than 10 mm shall retract, detach or bend over under a 10 daN force exerted at its most salient point in any direction parallel to the mounting surface.

requirements.quote: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm
requirements.text: After the ornament test, the remaining projections on the front external surface shall not project more than 10 mm.

requirements.quote: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface shall not be subject to the requirements of paragraph 6.1.1. above; however, they shall be firmly secured to the vehicle
requirements.text: Protective strips or shielding on the front external surface shall be firmly secured to the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The projection shall not exceed 40 mm in the case of door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases
requirements.text: Handles, hinges, push-buttons and fuel filler caps and covers on the vehicle shall not project more than 40 mm for door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases.

requirements.quote: the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm
requirements.text: The ends of the front bumper shall be turned in so that they are not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap to the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm, or the bumper shall be recessed or integrated in the bodywork.

requirements.quote: that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward
requirements.text: Where the bumper outline contour lies on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm from the contour line to 20 mm inward.

requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above does not apply to the bumper cover
requirements.text: The bumper cover shall be exempt from the bumper radius requirement but shall still comply with the general external surface requirements.

requirements.quote: Sheet-metal edges, such as gutter edges and the rails of sliding doors, shall not be permitted unless they are folded back or are fitted with a shield meeting the requirements of this Regulation
requirements.text: Sheet-metal edges of the front-end structure shall be folded back or fitted with a shield meeting the requirements of UN R26.

requirements.quote: Folds in body panels may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection
requirements.text: Folds in the front body panels may have a radius of curvature below 2.5 mm provided it is not less than one-tenth of the projection height H.

requirements.quote: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them
requirements.text: Jacking brackets and exhaust pipes shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying above them.

requirements.quote: an exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm
requirements.text: An exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the floor line only if it terminates in rounded edges of at least 2.5 mm radius.

requirements.quote: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. above in all positions of use
requirements.text: Air intake and outlet flaps on the front external surface shall meet the general requirements of paragraphs 5.2, 5.3 and 5.4 in all positions of use.

requirements.quote: At a height of more than 2 metres
requirements.text: Parts of the external front surface at a height of more than 2 m in the laden condition shall be exempt from the external projection requirements.

requirements.quote: So located that, in their static condition as well as when in operation, they cannot be contacted by a sphere 100 mm in diameter
requirements.text: Parts of the external front surface that cannot be contacted by a 100 mm diameter sphere in static or operating condition shall be exempt from the external projection requirements.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark
requirements.text: The vehicle shall carry an international approval mark affixed conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 4.1.4.1. above
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the E circle.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate.

requirements.quote: a= 8 mm min
requirements.text: The characters of the approval mark shall have a height of at least 8 mm.

requirements.quote: it shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel
requirements.text: The projection dimension of a component mounted on a non-convex front surface shall be determined using the 100 mm diameter sphere method of Annex 3 paragraph 2.2.

requirements.quote: The dimension of a gap or space between elements of a grille shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact of the sphere
requirements.text: The gap dimension between elements of a front grille shall be determined by the distance between two planes through the sphere contact points perpendicular to the line joining them.

requirements.quote: The height H of a projection is determined graphically by reference to the circumference of a 165 mm diameter circle
requirements.text: The height H of a fold in a front body panel shall be determined graphically against a 165 mm diameter circle internally tangential to the external outline.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation
requirements.text: The airbag control unit, belt pretensioners and their wiring shall be designed, constructed and fitted so that the vehicle complies with UN R10 in normal conditions of use.

requirements.quote: A vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances
requirements.text: The vehicle with its airbag and pretensioner electronics shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 10 m antenna spacing, the broadband radiated emission of the vehicle shall not exceed 32 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 75 MHz and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m from 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 43 dB microvolts/m
requirements.text: At a 10 m antenna spacing, the broadband radiated emission of the vehicle shall not exceed 43 dB microvolts/m from 400 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 3 m antenna spacing, the broadband radiated emission of the vehicle shall not exceed 42 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 75 MHz and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m from 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits
requirements.text: The measured broadband emission values of the vehicle shall remain below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 10 m antenna spacing, the narrowband radiated emission from the vehicle electronics shall not exceed 28 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 230 MHz and 35 dB microvolts/m from 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 3 m antenna spacing, the narrowband radiated emission from the vehicle electronics shall not exceed 38 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 230 MHz and 45 dB microvolts/m from 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The restraint system electronics shall be immune to a field strength of 30 V/m over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band and at least 25 V/m over the whole band.

requirements.quote: The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The restraint system electronics shall be immune to a field strength of 10 V/m over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band and at least 8 V/m over the whole band.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions"
requirements.text: During radiated immunity testing of the vehicle, the airbag and safety restraint functions shall show no degradation of performance.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band
requirements.text: The broadband radiated emission of the airbag control unit as an ESA shall not exceed 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 75 MHz (decreasing logarithmically) and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m from 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band
requirements.text: The narrowband radiated emission of the airbag control unit as an ESA shall not exceed 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 75 MHz (decreasing logarithmically) and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m from 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: Test level below 2 GHz 60 V/m 75 V/m 60 mA 30 V/m 21 V/m
requirements.text: The airbag control unit as an ESA shall be immune to test levels of 60 V/m (stripline), 75 V/m (TEM cell), 60 mA (BCI), 30 V/m (ALSE) and 21 V/m (reverberation chamber) over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: Test level above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 8 V/m 6 V/m
requirements.text: The airbag control unit as an ESA shall be immune to at least 8 V/m (ALSE) and 6 V/m (reverberation chamber) over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions"
requirements.text: During ESA radiated immunity testing, the airbag and restraint functions shall show no degradation of performance.

requirements.quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
requirements.text: The airbag control unit as an ESA shall withstand test pulse 3a of -112 V on 12 V supply lines for 1 h at functional performance status class I for immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses I III
requirements.text: The airbag control unit as an ESA shall withstand test pulse 2a of +37 V for 500 pulses at functional performance status class I for immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation
requirements.text: Every ESA such as the airbag control unit approved under UN R10 shall carry the approval mark described in paragraph 5.3.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval
requirements.text: The approval mark of the vehicle or ESA shall contain a circle with the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the granting country.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the E circle.

requirements.quote: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle
requirements.text: The approval marking on the airbag control unit need not be visible after installation in the vehicle.

requirements.quote: a = 6 mm min
requirements.text: The characters of the UN R10 approval mark shall have a height of at least 6 mm.

requirements.quote: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied
requirements.text: When the vehicle broadband emission is measured with peak detectors, a correction factor of 20 dB shall be applied.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an outdoor test site (OTS)
requirements.text: The radiated broadband emission limits shall apply over the whole 30 to 1,000 MHz range in an ALSE or outdoor test site.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector
requirements.text: The narrowband radiated emission of the vehicle shall be measured with an average detector.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be exposed to vertically polarised electromagnetic radiation over the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range during the immunity test.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation
requirements.text: The ambient noise during ESA broadband emission testing shall be at least 6 dB below the emission limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation
requirements.text: The ambient noise during ESA narrowband emission testing shall be at least 6 dB below the emission limits of paragraph 6.6.2.1.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1
requirements.text: The immunity of the airbag control unit shall be measured over the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines
requirements.text: The transient conducted emission of the airbag control unit shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on its supply lines and on other connections that may be operationally connected to supply lines.
